prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with neck and back strain after a hit while turning left. The patient had 6 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1164; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- Years ago the patient had a small strain in the same area that healed fully.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a motor vehicle collision in which the patient's vehicle was struck while turning left. The patient reported immediate neck and low back pain with stiffness. The mechanism and force of the impact are consistent with the injuries described. Examination revealed paraspinal muscle tenderness and reduced cervical range of motion, while neurological screening, reflexes, and strength testing were within normal limits. Imaging was not indicated at the time of initial evaluation. The patient also reports a remote soft tissue strain to the same region that resolved completely without lasting limitation. Care consisted of six office visits including manual therapy, stretching, and home exercise instruction. Recovery has been gradual, and the course of treatment extended somewhat beyond what is typical for this type of strain. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicate entries. Current assessment is a cervical and lumbar strain with ongoing improvement; further follow-up will be determined based on progress.
